results: Standard keeps nearest HH:mm, is opt-in owned only for widget input; no Max PV default
Days 1..7 use confirmation-day local calendar plus N, preserving HH:mm
Widget and EMS status expose identical central date immediately, no context run needed
Deadline/Guaranteed/Max PV patches preserve delivered kWh and newer central goal
Invalid horizon, past/invalid calendar dates and deadline beyond selected horizon preserve valid plan
Midnight does not move fixed deadline or refill progress; restart preserves all options
Unknown/null connection and a pause do not end widget plan; feedback display never becomes physical evidence
Connected widget goal defers latest ordinary Flow mode before state/output/context mutation
Clear resumes exactly latest saved ordinary Flow override via existing handler; other EV unaffected
Confirmed disconnect ends only widget plan and resumes latest Flow; first false after restart also ends it
Legacy Flow-created plans retain old disconnect/reconnect and ordinary mode precedence
Explicit Flow planning cards can replace widget plan; old stale widget patch preserves new Flow target
Completion stays protected/visible after restart and forbids further charging; clear resumes Flow
Expired absolute deadline survives restart and produces STOP, never a new tomorrow goal
Local calendar handles 23h/25h DST days and rejects nonexistent local wall time
PV resources reserve house and battery once; two EVs share remaining forecast without duplication
No intraday forecast profile: a full day total is never credited before morning/noon deadline
Max PV reduces planned grid deficit; Guaranteed latest safe start is based on FULL goal
Configured fixed/TOU multi-day curves use real tariff transitions/prices and configured permissions
Max PV without Guaranteed never widens cheap permission to expensive dynamic/TOU slots
Explicit safety/session-end feedback still stops during a widget plan and is never deferred
Unknown competing EV need blocks forecast credit, not the existing planner or live PV path
Tomorrow forecast reserves possible battery refill again; completed EV does not reserve PV
An entirely unpublished dynamic horizon stays provisional with zero cheap slots and retains safe start
Partial dynamic curves never invent future prices; future cheapest quarter remains selectable
